basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm Alex, a high school junior from Seattle, WA. I recently discovered Reddit and have been loving the mix of memes, gaming discussions, and random facts. I'm a huge fan of Shiba Inus and spend a lot of time watching funny pet videos. I also dabble in drawing and have been trying my hand at digital art. When I'm not online, I'm probably playing video games or hanging out with friends at the local skate park. I'm single and enjoying the freedom to explore my interests. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after school, around 7-10 PM PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a high school student, most of my knowledge comes from classes and my own curiosity. I have a keen interest in art and technology, which I explore through YouTube tutorials and online courses. I'm also really into gaming, mostly learning through trial and error and discussing strategies with friends and online communities.
